input_requirement: When System-A receives a message from Security Manager and if the message is part of the B-file, according to the mapping rules.

ambiguities.fragment: if the message is part of the B-file, according to the mapping rules
ambiguities.explanation: The prepositional phrase 'according to the mapping rules' has ambiguous attachment scope. It can modify the condition 'if the message is part of the B-file' (defining how membership is determined) or modify the entire preceding clause 'When System-A receives a message from Security Manager' (defining the context of the reception event).
possible_interpretations: The system checks if the message belongs to the B-file by applying the mapping rules, and if so, processes it.
The system processes messages received from the Security Manager according to the mapping rules, but only if those messages happen to be part of the B-file.

ambiguity_resolubility.fragment: if the message is part of the B-file, according to the mapping rules
ambiguity_resolubility.supported_interpretation: The system checks if the message belongs to the B-file by applying the mapping rules, and if so, processes it.
evidence_from_context: Business rule BR-01: 'When System-A receives a B-file message from Security Manager according to the mapping rules, System-A must forward the message...'
ambiguity_resolubility.justification: The business rule BR-01 explicitly links the condition 'receives a B-file message' with the action 'according to the mapping rules'. The phrasing 'receives a B-file message... according to the mapping rules' indicates that the determination of whether a message is a 'B-file message' (i.e., part of the B-file) is performed via the mapping rules. This supports the interpretation where the mapping rules define the membership condition, rather than applying to the reception event itself or a separate processing step independent of the classification.

structured_requirements.final_statement: When System-A receives a message from Security Manager and if the message belongs to the B-file by applying the mapping rules, the system shall process it.
structuring_notes: AMB-01 resolved: ambiguous fragment 'if the message is part of the B-file, according to the mapping rules' replaced with supported interpretation 'The system checks if the message belongs to the B-file by applying the mapping rules, and if so, processes it.' Core predicate is 'processes' (system action) → functional_requirement.
